family_contrast_orientation: higher_numeric_family_id minus lower_numeric_family_id; IDs remain Discovery-anchored

heldout_fingerprint_metrics.binary_gate_scope: descriptive characterization only; failure cannot invalidate structural_replication structural replication and success cannot establish a biological mechanism
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.bootstrap: 2000 participant-level bootstrap resamples per held-out split; deterministic seed namespace 540/signal_space_characterization
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.contrast_cosine: cosine between fixed Discovery contrast vector and held-out participant-balanced contrast vector
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.coordinate_sign_concordance: fraction of all 14 coordinates with same sign as Discovery reference
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.fingerprint_direction_replication_gate: for both Validation and Confirmation: bootstrap 95% lower CI of contrast cosine > 0 AND sign concordance >= 10/14
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.global_pair: reported separately; never counted as a seventh independent source block
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.non_global_block_contribution: sum of squared contrast coordinates for each RMS/cosine block pair divided by sum across coordinates 0..11
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.replicated_prominent_block_rule: block contribution > 1/6 in Discovery, Validation, and Confirmation AND at least one member coordinate satisfies the stable-coordinate rule
heldout_fingerprint_metrics.stable_coordinate_rule: same contrast sign in Discovery/Validation/Confirmation AND both held-out participant-bootstrap 95% CIs exclude zero in that same direction

interpretation_boundaries: RMS displacement is a magnitude-of-change descriptor, not activation strength or emotional intensity.
Cosine similarity is profile/directional preservation, not psychological similarity.
PLV-derived coordinates describe phase-locking/synchrony summaries and do not localize a generator.
Covariance-summary coordinates describe covariance structure and do not by themselves establish anatomical topology.
DCT coordinates describe temporal waveform structure and are not source-localized oscillatory generators.
Global coordinates are overlapping aggregate descriptors, not independent physiological systems.
Stable fingerprints may characterize signal geometry of replicated families; they do not make families true emotion kinds.
Low experience/report-transition overlap does not establish independent biological mechanisms.
topographic extension analysis conclusion remains binding; signal_space_characterization cannot rescue it with a renamed topographic analysis.

primary_estimation.Discovery_eligibility: all participants/trials in the prespecified discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_fit/discovery_report_transition_multiresolution_fit assignment tables
primary_estimation.family_centroid: participant-balanced: within-participant family mean, then equal-weight mean across eligible participants
primary_estimation.heldout_primary_eligibility: participant_eligible == True in prespecified transfer assignment tables
primary_estimation.pairwise_contrasts: all canonical pairwise family contrasts at every replicated K

primary_representation.coordinate_pairs: RMS displacement + cosine similarity for six non-global blocks, plus a two-coordinate global aggregate
primary_representation.coordinates: all 14 standardized signature coordinates; no coordinate subset selection

program_stages.physiological_characterization: analysis specification only; byte/hash verification, no structural values parsed
program_stages.discovery_physiological_reference_atlas: Discovery 14D reference atlas; all K and all pairwise contrasts, no selection
program_stages.heldout_physiological_transfer: Validation + Confirmation transfer of fixed 14D physiological fingerprints with prespecified metrics/gates
program_stages.signal_space_feature_decomposition: 169-feature source decomposition only for pre-prespecified replicated-prominent blocks; no scalp/topographic rescue
program_stages.physiological_synthesis: cross-split physiological synthesis and claims ledger; no new tests or semantics

scientific_role: outcome-free neurophysiological/feature-space characterization of already-replicated structural_replication families

source_decomposition_169.allowed_blocks: only blocks satisfying the pre-prespecified replicated-prominent-block rule; all features within each allowed block are emitted
source_decomposition_169.cosine_decomposition: per-feature contribution to the normalized dot product using the same zero-norm convention as discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_fit
source_decomposition_169.preprocessing_identity: must reproduce discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_fit stage_standardize/raw_signatures conventions; no new normalization tuned to signal_space_characterization results
source_decomposition_169.rms_decomposition: per-feature squared standardized stage difference, normalized within its prespecified block; signed stage difference retained separately
source_decomposition_169.stable_subfeature_rule: within an allowed block, contribution above the uniform 1/block_size reference in all three splits plus same-direction family contrast across all three; descriptive only
source_decomposition_169.stage: signal_space_feature_decomposition only, after heldout_physiological_transfer cross-split fingerprint results
